# ColorPicker

Header: `winui/ui/input/ColorPicker.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/input/ColorPicker.hpp`.

A hue/saturation/value/alpha color editor with channel, alpha and hex text entry and a preview swatch.

A container of independently focusable sub-controls, laid out vertically from the top: hue and saturation sliders beside the preview (standing in for the 2D spectrum, which is not drawn), the value slider, the alpha slider, an optional More button, then the text entry section (an RGB/HSV dropdown and a `#RRGGBB` hex box, three channel boxes and an Opacity box). [Tab](tabs.md#uitab) walks the parts in that order; the picker itself is never focused.

Every part has a `*_visible` switch. A hidden part is not laid out, drawn, hit-tested or reachable by [Tab](tabs.md#uitab), and showing it again needs no rebuild. A channel box applies a valid value as it is typed (0-255 for RGB, 0-359 hue, 0-100 saturation, value and opacity); Enter reverts invalid text. The hex box commits on Enter only: 6 or 8 hex digits (`#RRGGBBAA`, '#' optional, case-insensitive); anything else reverts.

Example: 
```cpp
auto row = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Horizontal);
ui::ColorPickerControl* picker = row->add(std::make_unique<ui::ColorPickerControl>(ui::Color::from_rgba(0, 120, 215),
                                                                            /*alpha_enabled=*/true));
picker->set_more_button_visible(true); // text entry collapsed behind "More"
ui::BorderControl* swatch = row->add(std::make_unique<ui::BorderControl>());
swatch->set_width(100.0f);
swatch->set_height(100.0f);
swatch->set_background(picker->color());
picker->on_color_changed([swatch](ui::Color c) { swatch->set_background(c); });
window.set_content(std::move(row));

// Declaratively, two-way through a Property (the equality gate stops the echo):
ui::Property<ui::Color> accent{ui::Color::from_rgba(0, 120, 215)};
window.set_content(ui::HorizontalStack{
    .spacing  = 16,
    .content  = {
        ui::ColorPicker{
            .color               = accent,
            .alpha_enabled       = true,
            .more_button_visible = true,
        },
        ui::Border{.background = ui::bind(accent, [](ui::Color c) { return std::optional{c}; }),
                          .width      = 100.0f,
                          .height     = 100.0f},
    },
});
```

## `ui::ColorPicker`

A hue/saturation/value/alpha color editor with channel, alpha and hex text entry and a preview swatch. Builds a [ui::ColorPickerControl](#uicolorpickercontrol). Each `*_visible` field shows or hides one part; [ui::ColorPickerControl](#uicolorpickercontrol)'s class comment describes the parts.

[`.color = prop`](#uicolorpicker-color) is two-way: it shows the property and writes the picked color back into it before [`on_color_changed`](#uicolorpicker-on_color_changed) runs.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<ui::Color> accent{ui::Color::from_rgba(0, 120, 215)};

window.set_content(ui::HorizontalStack{.spacing = 16, .content = {
    ui::ColorPicker{
        .color                = accent,
        .alpha_enabled        = true,
        .more_button_visible  = true,
        .horizontal_alignment = ui::Alignment::Leading,
    },
    ui::Border{.background = ui::bind(accent, [](ui::Color c) { return std::optional{c}; }),
               .width      = 100.0f,
               .height     = 100.0f},
}});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::ColorPicker{
    .color, .alpha_enabled, .spectrum_visible, .preview_visible, .color_slider_visible,
    .alpha_slider_visible, .more_button_visible, .color_channel_text_input_visible,
    .alpha_text_input_visible, .hex_input_visible, .style, .margin, .width, .height,
    .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_color_changed,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control
}
```

### ColorPickerControl

```cpp
ColorPickerControl(Color color = colors::Black, bool alpha_enabled = false)
```

A picker showing [`color`](#color); its alpha is kept only when [`alpha_enabled`](#alpha_enabled).

### ~ColorPickerControl

```cpp
~ColorPickerControl() override
```

Destroys the owned sub-controls.

### color

```cpp
Color color() const
```

The selected color, computed from the sliders' HSV values on every call. Opaque while [alpha_enabled()](#alpha_enabled) is false.

### set_color

```cpp
void set_color(Color color)
```

Forces alpha to 1 when [alpha_enabled()](#alpha_enabled) is false; updates every slider, box and the preview. Fires on_color_changed only if the resulting color differs from the current one.

### alpha_enabled

```cpp
bool alpha_enabled() const
```

Whether the alpha channel is shown and honored; false by default. While false, the alpha slider and box are hidden regardless of their own switches and the color is opaque.

### set_alpha_enabled

```cpp
void set_alpha_enabled(bool enabled)
```

Turns the alpha channel on or off. Turning it off makes the color opaque, firing on_color_changed if that changes it.

### spectrum_visible

```cpp
bool spectrum_visible() const
```

Whether the hue and saturation sliders show; true by default.

### set_spectrum_visible

```cpp
void set_spectrum_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the hue and saturation sliders standing in for the spectrum. Hiding them stretches the preview across the row at 44 DIPs tall. Updates the layout.

### preview_visible

```cpp
bool preview_visible() const
```

Whether the preview swatch shows; true by default.

### set_preview_visible

```cpp
void set_preview_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the swatch showing the current color. Updates the layout.

### color_slider_visible

```cpp
bool color_slider_visible() const
```

Whether the value slider shows; true by default.

### set_color_slider_visible

```cpp
void set_color_slider_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the value slider. Updates the layout.

### alpha_slider_visible

```cpp
bool alpha_slider_visible() const
```

Whether the alpha slider shows; true by default, but shown only while [alpha_enabled()](#alpha_enabled) too.

### set_alpha_slider_visible

```cpp
void set_alpha_slider_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the alpha slider, shown only while [alpha_enabled()](#alpha_enabled) too. Updates the layout.

### more_button_visible

```cpp
bool more_button_visible() const
```

Whether the More button shows; false by default.

### set_more_button_visible

```cpp
void set_more_button_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the More button. While shown, the text entry section is collapsed until the button is clicked. Updates the layout.

### color_channel_text_input_visible

```cpp
bool color_channel_text_input_visible() const
```

Whether the channel inputs show; true by default.

### set_color_channel_text_input_visible

```cpp
void set_color_channel_text_input_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the RGB/HSV dropdown and the three channel boxes. Hiding them moves the hex box to the left. Updates the layout.

### alpha_text_input_visible

```cpp
bool alpha_text_input_visible() const
```

Whether the Opacity box shows; true by default, but shown only while [alpha_enabled()](#alpha_enabled) too.

### set_alpha_text_input_visible

```cpp
void set_alpha_text_input_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the Opacity box, shown only while [alpha_enabled()](#alpha_enabled) too. Updates the layout.

### hex_input_visible

```cpp
bool hex_input_visible() const
```

Whether the `#RRGGBB` box shows; true by default.

### set_hex_input_visible

```cpp
void set_hex_input_visible(bool visible)
```

Shows or hides the `#RRGGBB` box. Updates the layout.

### more_expanded

```cpp
bool more_expanded() const
```

Whether the text entry section is expanded behind the More button. Meaningless while the button is hidden, when the section is always shown.

### on_color_changed

```cpp
void on_color_changed(Callback<void(Color)> handler)
```

Fired with the new color whenever [`color`](#color) changes, from a slider drag, a click-to-jump on any channel's track, a keyboard step, a typed channel value, a committed hex edit or [set_color()](#set_color) alike. Replaces any previous handler.

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

Lists the shown sub-controls in [Tab](tabs.md#uitab) order, so a hidden part gets no focus, input, animation or automation. The picker itself is never a tab stop.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Stacks the shown parts at the available width; the height follows from what is shown.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Places every shown part.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the shown sub-controls, the channel labels and the preview swatch.

### clear_dirty_override

```cpp
void clear_dirty_override(DirtyFlags flags) override
```

Reaches every sub-control, shown or not, unlike [for_each_child()](#for_each_child), so a part that comes back into view does not carry flags from before it was hidden.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.
